author: alexsign-source
body: I checked previous GOA/QuickGO releases. This annotation seems to be present in March and April release. Then it disappeared from May and June releases. Now it's back to PAINT files again and should be part of next GOA/QuickGO release. Unfortunately I don't keep all version of PAINT files I download and cannot pinpoint exact date when data was there and when not.
